description_long: Entry 1716 remains on hold because its source packet does not identify the Trump campaign promise allegedly exposed by AP’s tracker, nor an AP row or archived capture showing that promise’s reported status on March 4, 2026. The only final-pass query was: “site:apnews.com/projects/trump-campaign-promise-tracker "March 4, 2026" Trump promise status pledge tracker.” Firecrawl returned an empty result set. No relevant new source was available to read, and the previously attempted AP tracker URL was not retried: the preserved prior terminal reports HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge and no tracker text. The packet’s description of AP’s general tracker purpose cannot establish a particular pledge, a date-specific result, or a distinct Trump action on this date. Accordingly, this terminal proposes no replacement event and does not support the continuing-exposure claim. Keep the existing text untouched pending evidence that names the pledge and documents its status on the exact date.
